description:
Source issue: https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/issues/834
Parent contract: zaq-zqq (read before implementation).

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
lib/zaq/engine/conversations.ex, conversations/message.ex and history_ingress.ex; corresponding admission/capture tests. insert_admitted_message currently saves author_id but not the resolved Person reference; Message.changeset currently omits provider_sent_at/history_context. Add a narrowly trusted write path preserving provider_sent_at and history_context.author_person_id. Do not globally trust browser/LLM attrs. Preserve canonical/legacy Message UUIDs, source identity, raw content, trace boundaries and finalization/replay invariants. Reuse existing JSON storage; no schema migration or speculative backfill is planned. Add virtual projection fields as needed without changing existing Message struct consumers.
Tests to add before implementation: verified BO/channel authors, provider time persistence, insertion-time fallback data, forged Person fields, conflicting replay, canonical adoption of admitted rows, assistant finalization, missing historical author references.
Branches/paths validated: user/external versus assistant authors; capture versus execution admission; source replay/canonical association; generic add_message and PersistMessageHistory cannot elevate supplied person/name fields to verified authorship. Validate attribution during canonical reuse rather than overwriting a conflicting original reference.
Mocking plan: real Repo/domain transactions; only genuine external connector boundaries may be mocked.
Documentations to update: Message/Conversations/HistoryIngress module contracts and docs/services/engine.md trusted author/timestamp persistence rules.
Action reuse assessment: extend existing admission/capture/persistence domain APIs. Author stamping is a local domain detail, not a standalone exposed Action. Inputs are verified ingress/admission facts; output is the same persisted Message identity with protected author reference and source time. Preserve existing errors, permissions, idempotency and transactional side effects. Test real consumers and replay failures.
Acceptance: a delayed/queued message retains original persisted provider time, raw content and author evidence; unsupported legacy evidence remains unknown.

Completed on feature/issue-834-message-attribution. Added Message.admission_changeset/3 for Engine-resolved author/time facts; ordinary changeset still ignores supplied history_context/provider time. Shared insert_message preserves existing post-insert side effects. Canonical reuse retains original Person reference and source time, rejects conflicting resolved authors, and supports merged aliases without rewriting the original reference. Added persistence property and integration regressions; documented the contract. Virtual projection fields remain in task .4 where consumed. Test-first failures observed for missing author and canonical overwrite/conflict. Final validation: mix q passed; 7 properties, 140 tests, 0 failures across message_attribution, canonical_history_capture, history_ingress, transcript_history, execution_history suites. git diff --check clean. No commit/push/PR performed.
title: [#834] Persist verified message authors and provider timestamps
